question: Must exact head 9f22a0dcf33d9528cd7e392c09d31aef6a945655 complete a privileged GCP create/use/delete lifecycle before merge, or is the existing split real-provider proof sufficient?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and includes real after-fix evidence, but only maintainers can set the required proof depth for releasing a new security-sensitive credential boundary.

options.title: Require exact-head lifecycle

options.title: Accept split proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the earlier successful Compute request together with exact-head token acquisition, expected IAM denial, SHA verification, hosted checks, and cleanup evidence.
